newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commission President Jacques Santer had met World Bank President James Wolfensohn in the morning. He said views on the priorities in the two institutions' cooperation policy with Africa were very close. He also said Wolfensohn would meet other Commissioners in the afternoon and that a note would be available at 1500/1400 GMT.

Vale de Almeida said the heads of states and governments of eight West-African countries would meet in Brussels on Thursday in the framework of a conference on the economic and monetary union of west Africa. He said they should meet Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro at lunchtime. He said meetings with other Commissioners and with Commission President Jacques Santer were scheduled.

Vale de Almeida said African issues should also be discussed during Thursday's Development Council and that the Commission green paper on future relations with ACP countries should be adopted this week.

Spokesman Timo Pesonen briefed on Tuesday's Budget Council. He said discussions would focus on the second reading of the 1997 draft Community budget. He said the Council would receive a delegation from the European Parliament for consultation on budgetary issues.

Vale de Almeida said the issue of human rights had been discussed during various contacts between the EU and the Chinese authorities. He said journalists would be briefed on Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan's return from Asia. - - - -
The Commission released the following documents:
- Speech/96/295: Speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan at the World Economic Forum's East Asia summit.
- Speech/96/297: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "from margin to mainstream".
